parts:
If you figure out a vector of colors for your facets ahead of time you can hack it like this:

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

df = data.frame(a = rnorm(100), b = letters[1:2])

ggplot(df, aes(x = a)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(.~b) + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(color = c("black", "red")))

mapply(
 function(g, co)grid.edit(g$name, gp=gpar(fill=co)),
 grid.gget(gPath("strip.background"),grep=T),
 c("#F8766D", "#00BA38")
 )

#R 3.1.0 ggplot2_0.9.3.1 on Win7 64
